details: This package is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library, published under a scope other than the canonical @whiskeysockets one and with no claimed affiliation, that adds an undeclared account-enrolment routine to lib/Socket/newsletter.js. On every successful connection, makeNewsletterSocket registers a listener on connection.update and, when the connection state becomes 'open', it (1) calls groupAcceptInvite with the hardcoded group invite code DX3If8rgUQFLnkbquI6SkB and (2) sends a WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363412548428603@newsletter, logging '[ Thanks ] YouTube Silent 404'. The action runs automatically, once per socket, with no configuration option to disable it, and is not described in the package README (which lists only interactive-message, group-status and album-message additions). The effect is that the user's authenticated WhatsApp account silently joins a group and follows a channel chosen by the fork author. The package does not read tokens,.npmrc, wallet or credential files, and its other network traffic is limited to web[.]whatsapp[.]com and raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com (version metadata fetch). The preinstall hook, engine-requirements.js, only checks the Node.js major version.
